10. Snowmobiles should not be allowed in hunting areas during hunting seasons.
11. All terrain vehicles should be governed by the same regulations that control four-wheel drive vehicles and snowabiles. They should only be allowed on well established roads or four-wheel drive trails. During the winter they should be allowed to use only those overs which snowabiles may use.
12. Lond management agencies should set allowable noise levels for off-rord vehicles. I suggest that a maximum allowable noise level of 70-75 db be set. I do not propose that the noise regulations apply to machines used only on race courses.
